pr_open: A real pull request, opened by an agent. Git finds no conflict.
pr_comment: The memory review reads it as graph facts. It names the contradiction and the path that proves it.
pr_check: The required memory-review check fails, so main does not take this merge.
pr_pass: A correct change from another agent. The memory review passes.
live_hero: The same review runs live in a web page. Nothing to install.
play_open: Write a memory yourself. Say payments-api uses mysql-8. Relate blocks it in the page.
play_fix1: Replace the old fact. Three facts rest on it, so the review still blocks.
play_merge: Merge. The page's memory now holds your fact.
live_stale: A stale clone. Git merges it cleanly. The graph loses a note and its links.
live_cypher: Ask it in Cypher. Relate runs inside the page as WebAssembly.
live_break: Now write with Cypher. A second port for checkout-web. The review reruns and blocks.
